about.title: I spent the last decade building data narratives for the world's largest companies.
about.vodafone_impact: From anonymized pings to saving lives.
about.vodafone_p1: At Vodafone Global Enterprise, I worked as a Global Proposition Development Manager. My job was to take billions of anonymized mobile location data points and turn them into solutions that people could actually understand and use.
about.vodafone_p2: This meant building partnerships with global giants like JCDecaux to analyze out-of-home media, and breaking down demographic movements across major transit hubs.
about.vodafone_highlight: "One of my proudest moments was using location data to improve cyclist safety along London's Super Cycle Highway for Transport for London. Seeing data translate directly into saved lives is exactly why I dedicate a portion of my time to social good initiatives today."
about.fb_p1: Later, as a Global Insights, Analytics and Reporting Manager at Facebook, I had to figure out how to communicate massive, complex metrics to the C-suite and enterprise partners.
about.fb_bullet1: Created the first new section in 6 years for the global quarterly report deck.
about.fb_bullet2: Built bespoke spending analysis workflows for enterprise customers over Cyber Weekend.
about.fb_bullet3: Analyzed credit utilization rates across a massive $35bn portfolio.
about.pitch_title: Now, I want to bring that enterprise-grade rigor to your project.
about.pitch_body: Whether you're a lean startup, a growing NGO, or a researcher with a breakthrough—you deserve the same level of clarity and visual storytelling that the Fortune 500 rely on.

personas.researcher_problem: You have deep, robust data but struggle to make it accessible to a broader audience without losing nuance.
personas.researcher_solution: "I need to turn this 50-page technical paper into interactive visuals that people will actually understand and share."
personas.executive_problem: You are drowning in messy spreadsheets and confusing dashboards that don't highlight the key takeaways.
personas.executive_solution: "I need a clean, automated reporting structure so my board can make fast, informed decisions."
personas.policy_problem: You need to persuade the public and shape policy, but raw statistics are dry and easily ignored.
personas.policy_solution: "I need a compelling visual narrative that makes our impact undeniable to the press and the public."
personas.law_problem: You need to untangle complex criminal and financial networks to identify key actors and present evidence clearly.
personas.law_solution: "I need interactive custom solutions and network analysis that make our findings undeniable in court or briefings."
